title: 4/5 — the rep was polite, but please actually check my account this time before replying. Last time an agent told me the second $89 was just a "temporary authorization, clears in 3 days" and closed the ticket — that was wrong. The money stayed held, and when I called my bank they said it wasn't a normal authorization at all: it was tied to a fraud review already open on my account, case CASE-4471.

I've compared the current invoice against your prior support history and replied on **TKT-91842**. Summary:

**Current invoice (INV-30984):**
- $89 settled charge (TXN-711204) — your actual July subscription payment.
- $89 pending authorization (AUTH-711203) — a hold, expected to release in ~3 business days.

**What happened last time (TKT-77106, March):** You were told the second $89 was "just a temporary authorization, clears in 3 days," and the ticket was closed with no refund. Your follow-up survey noted this was wrong — your bank said the hold was actually tied to an internal fraud review (not a normal authorization), and it didn't clear as promised.

**Bottom line for now:**
- The settled $89 is legitimate — no refund needed there.
- The pending $89 is a hold, not a charge, so technically no refund applies yet — but given it turned out not to be a routine authorization last time, I'm not taking that claim at face value again. I've escalated the ticket to verify what this pending entry actually is and to make sure it releases on schedule (or gets refunded/released manually if it doesn't).

I'll update TKT-91842 once that's confirmed rather than closing it out on assumption.

arguments.body:
Hi Devon,

Thanks for flagging this, and for the extra context — I did pull both the current invoice and your prior ticket history before replying.

Here's what INV-30984 shows right now:
- TXN-711204: $89, settled — this is your July Pro subscription charge.
- AUTH-711203: $89, pending authorization — currently showing an expected release within 3 business days.

On the surface, that looks identical to what you were told back in March on TKT-77106. However, I also saw your follow-up survey noting that last time, the "temporary authorization" explanation turned out to be incomplete — the hold didn't clear as described and was actually tied to an internal review on your account, not a standard authorization.

Given that history, I'm not comfortable just repeating the same "it'll auto-clear in 3 days" answer without verification this time. I'm escalating this ticket internally so someone can specifically confirm whether the current $89 pending entry is a plain card authorization or something else, and make sure it's actually released on schedule rather than assuming it will be.

To be clear on where things stand:
- Only one $89 charge (TXN-711204) has actually settled and been paid — that one is correct and not being refunded, as it matches your subscription.
- The second $89 (AUTH-711203) has not settled/charged you; it's a hold. No refund applies to a hold, but if it does not release within the 3-business-day window (or if the internal review turns up something different), we will process a refund or release it manually rather than leaving it open-ended.

I'll follow up on this same ticket once I have confirmation, and definitely before closing it this time. Thanks for your patience, and sorry for the runaround last time.
